what: Live Task Progress Tracking in ContextPack and Spec Engine: Implement ParseTaskProgress to parse markdown checklist tasks and surface real-time task completion metrics across ContextPack and MCP tools.
why: Provide real-time visibility into task execution progress for AI agents without manual overhead.
learned: Pure Go parser counting checkboxes and calculating percentage completion; integrated into ContextChange and rendered into RenderContextPack and tools_spec.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
